welcome_0: Welcome aboard Aurora. Your fare is confirmed. Settle in, and I'll take you there.
welcome_1: Hello there. Doors closing. You can enjoy the journey, or choose skip journey on your phone.
welcome_2: Good to see you. I'm your autonomous Aurora. No driver, no awkward small talk. Unless you fancy a chat.
traffic_0: I'm following the signals and keeping a safe gap. If you are in a hurry, you can skip the rest of this journey.
traffic_1: A little traffic ahead. I'll wait for a clear road. Your quoted fare stays the same.
traffic_2: Nottingham traffic. A fine opportunity to admire the view. Shall we skip ahead? That's entirely up to you.
area_0: Victoria Centre and Gedling are on our local network. You can search for a house number, street, park or bus stop on your phone.
area_1: The parks have football, swings, a slide and a timed running lap. A good place to stretch your legs after the journey.
area_2: Every council home has its own number. Visit the front door to view the rent before taking a tenancy.
help_0: Press B to change the camera. Press J to skip the journey once the doors have closed. Your fare is only charged once.
help_1: You can apply for work at the council office. Attend your assignment to earn wages, then pay for rent and travel in pounds.
help_2: Buses stop for passengers on the pavement, away from junctions. Watch the number and destination before boarding.
arrival_0: Here we are. Your journey is complete. Please step out onto the pavement. Have a lovely day.
arrival_1: We've arrived safely. Thank you for travelling with Aurora. Mind the pavement as you step out.
arrival_2: Destination reached. Another successful journey, and I didn't even ask you to rate my driving. Take care.
quiet_0: Of course. I'll keep quiet for the rest of your journey.
quiet_1: Certainly. Enjoy the view. I'll let you know when we arrive.
quiet_2: Peace and quiet it is. My speciality.
